system.description:
Play a Losejas to wield great demonic power at big costs.

SPELLCASTING TRAIT: CHARM

Sanderis is the sorcery of Sarmatia, where a Losejas forges a contract with a powerful otherworldly being called a dieva. The Losejas seeks the dieva’s true name to destroy it, while the dieva corrupts its host to break free; only one can prevail. Losejai are bound within a strict order known as the Ratas (the Circle). Those who defy it are hunted by the Purifiers, agents specialised in eliminating rogue sorcerers.
